content: Gallas Gallas Shiiqiza Yarsho
GODAY Muses,
«Neni Isra7eele asaas, ‹Iza sawoy tunnu gi tana ufayssana mala xuugettiza kaththa yarsho woden woden naagidi istti taas shiishshana mala ne istta azaza› ga yoota.
Qasseka isttas, ‹Taman xuugettidi taas shiiqana yarshoy hayssafe kaallizayssa; istta bolla wosoy baynda layth gidiza nam7u dharsho laaqqata gallas gallas shiiqi xuugettiza yarshos shiishshite.
Issi laaqqa maalado nam7anththoza omarsa wode shiishshite.
Issi issi laaqqara issi kilo gidiza liiqo dhiille issi litiro gidiza wogara zayten munuqettidi kaththa yarsho gidi shiiqo.
Hessika gallas gallas shiiqiza xuugettiza yarsho; hessa mala yarsho sawoy tana GODAA ufayssiza yarsho gididi koyro Siina zumaa bolla shiiqana mala wogay wodhdhides.
Koyro laaqqazara shiiqiza ushsha yarshoy issi litiro gidiza mino ushshu geeshshasozan GODAAS gussite.
Omarsa wode nam7anththo laaqqaza koyroyssaththoka ushsha yarshoza gujjidi shiishshite; hessa sawoykka GODAA ufayssiza kaththa yarsho gidana.
Sambata Gallassa Yarsho
« ‹Sambata gallas, layth gidida wosoy istta bolla baynda nam7u dharsho laaqqata, ushsha yarshoranne nam7u kilo gidiza liiqo dhiille wogara zayten munuqidi kaththa yarsho histti shiishshite.
Hayssi ha yarshozi ushsha yarshozappenne gallas gallas xuugettiza yarshozappe Sambata gallas gallas shiiqiza hara xuugettiza yarsho.
Aginan Aginan Shiiqiza Yarsho
« ‹Aginan aginan koyro gallas gallas istta bolla wosoy baynda nam7u mirgota, issi dharshonne layth kumida laappun dharsho laaqqata GODAAS xuugettiza yarsho histti shiishshite.

Issi issi mirgora kaththa yarshos heedzdzu kilo gidiza liiqo dhiille wogara zayten munuqidi shiishshite; qasse dharshozara kaththa yarshos nam7u kilo gidiza liiqo dhiille wogara zayten munuqi shiishshite;
issi issi dharsho laaqqara kaththa yarshos issi kilo gidiza liiqo dhiille wogara zayten munuqi shiishshite; he xuugettiza yarshota ubbaa sawoy GODAA ufayssiza kaththa yarsho gidi shiiqo.

Issi issi mirgora nam7u litiro gidiza woyne ushshu, dharshozara issi litironne sayso gidiza woyne ushshunne issi issi laaqqara issi litiro gidiza woyne ushshu yarshos shiishshite; hessika aginan aginan layth kumeth shiiqiza xuugettiza yarsho.
Gallas gallas xuugettiza yarshonne izara shiiqiza ushsha yarshoza bolla deysha orge nagara gishshas yarsho gidana mala GODAA sinth shiishshite.
Paaziga Ba7aalenne Ukeththa Ba7aale
« ‹GODAAS Paaziga ba7aale koyro aginay gelida tammanne oydanththo gallas bonchchite.
Ha aginay gelida tammanne ichchashanththo gallassafe doommidi ukeththa ba7aale bonchchite; he gallassafe biidi laappun gallas gakkanaas uketh miite.
Ba7aalezas koyro gallas goynnanaas shiiqite; he gallas ay oosokka ooththofte.
Istta bolla wosoy baynda 2 mirgota, issi dharshonne layth kumida laappun dharsho laaqqata xuugettiza yarsho histti GODAAS shiishshite.

Issi issi mirgora kaththa yarshos heedzdzu kilo gidiza liiqo dhiille wogara zayten munuqidi shiishshite; qasse dharshozara kaththa yarshos nam7u kilo gidiza liiqo dhiille wogara zayten munuqi shiishshite.
Issi issi dharsho laaqqara kaththa yarshos issi kilo gidiza liiqo dhiille wogara zayten munuqi shiishshite.
Qasseka nagara wursanaas deysha orge nagara yarshos shiishshite.
Heyti wurikka shiiqanay ubba wode maalado maalado xuugetti shiiqiza yarshora issife shiiqetto.
GODAA sawo tunnu giidi ufayssiza kaththa yarsho laappun gallas kumeth issi malan shiishshite; hessaka gallas gallas shiiqiza xuugettiza yarsho bollanne ushsha yarsho bolla gujjidi shiishshite.
Laappunththo gallas goynnanaas shiiqite; he gallas ay oosokka ooththofte.
Kaththa Shiisho Ba7aale
« ‹Kaththa shiishon ba7aale bonchchiza koyro gallas intte oorath gakkiza kaththaafe xeeraa GODAAS shiishshiza gallas goynnana shiiqiteppe attiin hara ay oosokka ooththofte.
Nam7u mirgota, issi dharshonne layth kumida laappun dharsho laaqqata sawo tunnu giidi GODAA ufayssiza xuugettiza yarsho shiishshite.

Issi issi mirgora kaththa yarshos heedzdzu kilo gidiza liiqo dhiille wogara zayten munuqidi shiishshite; qasse dharshozara kaththa yarshos nam7u kilo gidiza liiqo dhiille wogara zayten munuqi shiishshite;
issi issi dharsho laaqqara kaththa yarshos issi kilo gidiza liiqo dhiille wogara zayten munuqi shiishshite.
Qasseka nagara wursanaas deysha orge nagara yarshos shiishshite.
Hessa he yarshoza ubbaa ushsha yarshora, he gallas shiiqi xuugettiza yarshozanne kaththa yarshoza bolla gujjidi shiishshite; he yarsho meheti wosoy bayndayta gididayssa shaakki erite.
